entries.calculation: Observed kept and broken contract counts from the captured import-linter execution.
entries.validity: Missing or invalid execution evidence is unavailable; configured contract count is not an executed result.
entries.interpretation: Broken contracts follow the existing architecture gate; contract counts are not a quality percentage.

entries.scope: selected safety modules; separate scheduled run
entries.calculation: No branch percentage is inferred from the PR line-coverage profile.
entries.validity: Unavailable in the PR report unless separately captured evidence has its own matching identity.
entries.interpretation: Scheduled branch evidence cannot replace the current PR line measurement or create a new gate.

entries.calculation: Radon cyclomatic complexity for each observed callable definition.
entries.validity: Positive integer complexity with a unique source location; source errors make total population unknown.
entries.interpretation: Rank descending value then path, definition line and qualified name; top 10 is an excerpt. Xenon/Ruff and exception policies remain separate.

entries.scope: static internal imports aggregated at avo.<package>
entries.calculation: CA counts distinct incoming packages; CE counts distinct outgoing packages. Same-package and self edges are omitted; instability is CE/(CA+CE).
entries.validity: Missing or invalid graph is unavailable; instability is undefined when CA+CE is zero.
entries.interpretation: Informational static connectivity; external/dynamic imports and runtime calls are not measured. Package values cannot be relabeled as files.

entries.calculation: CA counts distinct incoming modules; CE counts distinct outgoing modules. Include same-package imports, deduplicate edges and exclude self edges; instability is CE/(CA+CE).
entries.validity: Every actual file has its source hash; namespace-only containers have null paths and hashes. Invalid graph is unavailable; zero-degree instability is undefined.
entries.interpretation: CE horizontal, CA vertical. Raw medians include all actual files and isolates; equality is lower. F IDs sort by path; coincident numbered G groups sort by (CE, CA) and map to a below-plot file index plus full text/JSON membership. Disclosed piecewise log2(1+count) spacing centers each raw median to form four equal-area quadrants; tick labels remain raw counts. Colored regions and median references describe informational connectivity, never gate outcomes or architectural verdicts.

entries.validity: Nonnegative integer counts, positive denominator and covered <= total; missing or inconsistent evidence is unavailable, not zero.
entries.interpretation: Minimum gate uses frozen coverage precision; raw value controls the band. Below limit is red; from limit to limit+0.25*(100-limit) is yellow; at or above that margin is green. A 100% floor requires exactly 100%.

entries.scope: src/avo; same-function complexity and line coverage
entries.validity: Requires valid same-function statement counts and successful same-source coverage proof. Missing inputs remain unmeasured; valid partial populations stay partial.
entries.interpretation: Reference 30 is informational. Rank observed scores descending then path, definition line and qualified name; show top 10 with measured/unmeasured and unknown population context.

entries.calculation: Observed findings and unwaived findings from the captured analyzer output; configured entries and observed matches are separate counts.
entries.validity: Incomplete or invalid analyzer evidence is unavailable or explicitly partial; missing reasons are not invented.
entries.interpretation: Unwaived/stale exceptions follow existing gate policy; allowlist size is not removed defects or test efficacy.

entries.scope: frozen Python dev + MCP dependencies and npm lock
entries.calculation: Keep Python advisory findings, npm severity counts and blocking findings separate; never sum unlike counting units into a defect total.
entries.validity: Incomplete raw audits remain partial and cannot imply zero findings; recorded waiver context is distinct from observed findings.
entries.interpretation: Existing unwaived Python advisory and npm-critical policy blocks; other npm severities are reported. Configuration is not a measurement.

entries.calculation: 100 * duplicatedLines / lines; reported percentage must agree within 0.01 percentage points.
entries.validity: Nonnegative integer counts, positive denominator, duplicated <= total and clone-pair list required; missing/inconsistent evidence is unavailable.
entries.interpretation: Direct percent with maximum gate. Above ceiling is red; above 0.75*ceiling through ceiling is yellow; at or below 0.75*ceiling is green. No goodness conversion.

entries.scope: captured unit and CLI/MCP/media integration suites
entries.grain: testcase execution event within its suite
entries.calculation: Count observed passed, failed, errored and skipped testcase events; total equals their sum.
entries.validity: Conflicting outcomes or invalid receipt/XML are unavailable; partial execution retains explicitly observed counts and recorded reasons.
entries.interpretation: Repeated executions are not additional unique tests. Success is execution evidence, not a quality percentage; missing reasons remain unavailable.

entries.scope: frozen mutation profile; selected Python modules
entries.calculation: 100 * killed / (killed + survived), only when every mutant has a killed or survived verdict and total is positive.
entries.validity: Nonnegative integer outcomes must reconcile with total. Every supported unresolved category and unaccounted remainder withhold efficacy; profile/floor and commit/run must match.
entries.interpretation: Minimum frozen profile floor; raw band uses the minimum margin rule. Unresolved outcomes are not kills or equivalent mutants; scopes and runs are not pooled.

entries.calculation: Report proposed added, removed and changed package counts with their separate units/context.
entries.validity: Missing/invalid output is unavailable; command outcome and proposal completeness remain distinct.
entries.interpretation: Report-only hoist proposal; no package change is claimed applied and no quality percentage is inferred.
